chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Make E

params.fingers: middle(2) A 2nd, ring(3) D 2nd, index(1) G 1st
params.open_strings: low E and B ring open

exercises.coaching: E: middle on A second fret, ring on D second, index on G first. Low E and B ring open. Bright, powerful — the root of rock and blues.

exercises.name: E↔A, A↔Em
exercises.purpose: Connect the new chord to its neighbours.
exercises.coaching: E to A, A to Em, back. These three share hand positions, so the changes are small. Smooth them and the cowboy set is complete.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: E completes your open-chord toolkit — the classic "cowboy" set. Bright, loud, the root of countless songs.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: E: middle on A second, ring on D second, index on G first. Low E and B open. A big, ringing chord.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: E to A, A to Em. They share hand shapes, so the moves are tiny. Smooth them and you have the full set.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: With E in, your open-chord vocabulary is complete. Every campfire song is now within reach.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Cowboy set done: E, A, Em, Am, C, G, D. Lesson 17 we add color with Dm and minor progressions.
